text_block_list.name: Aurum & Peerless
text_block_list.text: —Uwoooooooh!!! —Yaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Cheval
text_block_list.text: —Daaaaaaaahhh!!! —Haaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... the music I was searching 
for...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah— The world is... one...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Stupendo... Grazie infinite...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That was an insaaane race!! I-I can't 
stop getting goosebumps...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... thank goodness... Seriously, 
whenever Sounds of Earth is in a race, it 
just gets so heated and fun.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Totally! There are so many legendary 
races!! Earth and her whole generation are 
insanely hype every single time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I'll use this frustration as a 
springboard.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will make it in time, no matter what...! 
For the Arima Kinen...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."DSTY". Right now, in this moment... it 
"diverged".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, this calls for... a 
“congratulations,” doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...That was an incredible race, 
Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like... I was able to give 
it my all and feel good about it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I get it...! Surely this must be—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
――Nicely done, Earth! That felt better 
than anything you've ever shown before...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Right? It really feels like we showed them 
everything we've got...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Grazie, to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm truly glad that you all are my 
peers—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(And... it was precisely because today's 
race let me hear such unprecedented 
heights that I was able to realize it.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(This will be the final piece... to create 
an even more ultimate melody at the 'Arima 
Kinen'...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttrice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I welcomed Sounds of Earth with everything 
I had after she reached a brilliant peak 
at the Japan Cup, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I had an intuition. Not from 
words, but from the "sound" radiating from 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds of Earth ran a magnificent race 
today. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She holds total conviction that she can 
make the Arima Kinen even more 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as expected, Direttore. Perhaps 
words are no longer needed between us."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as expected, Direttrice. Perhaps 
words are no longer needed between us."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Ms. Sounds of Earth! Please tell us about 
your future plans!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Will you be running in this year's Arima 
Kinen!? Fan expectations are riding high—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's just perfect.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Tell everyone. I will run in the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And then... in a race where the greatest 
stage, the greatest Umamusume, and the 
greatest frenzy all collided—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I will win without fail. For it is I who 
shall take the conductor's podium."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I knew immediately. Her "declaration of 
victory" was packed with unprecedented 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That this is... the final piece needed to 
make the Arima Kinen a race that surpasses 
even today.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Has Sounds of Earth ever declared 
victory so seriously like this before...? 
It's kind of rare!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's always been saying stuff like 'I'm 
going to win' before, but... Saying that 
for the Arima Kinen is super bold...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you going all out, things are 
really heating up again~! Man, this is 
what makes Earth so fun!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
You really can't afford to miss this 
year's Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Today comes to an end... Bringing us one 
step closer to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, truly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen' approaches, gathering 
the fervent passion of a vast crowd."
